lines.zh: 我的腿有时候会跳一段。
lines.en: My legs sometimes skip a stretch.

lines.zh: 走三步，缺一帧。
lines.en: Three steps, and one frame goes missing.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟不上我自己。
lines.en: My shadow can't keep up with me.

lines.zh: 泥地上留下错位的蹄印。
lines.en: My hoofprints land out of line in the mud.

lines.zh: 我边走边掉像素。
lines.en: Pixels drop off me as I walk.

lines.zh: 鼻子拱着地，拱出一串乱码。
lines.en: My snout nuzzles the dirt into gibberish.

lines.zh: 我绕圈走，走回刚才那块地。
lines.en: I walk in a loop back to the same patch.

lines.zh: 我身上有一块怎么都补不上。
lines.en: There's a patch on me that never fills in.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩下去，草变成了黑色。
lines.en: My hoof lands and the grass turns black.

lines.zh: 我歪着走，像被谁拉了一把。
lines.en: I walk crooked, as if something keeps tugging me.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的脚步在重复。
lines.en: I hear my own footsteps repeating.

lines.zh: 我穿过栅栏，栅栏没拦住我。
lines.en: I pass through the fence. It doesn't stop me.

lines.zh: 我走路的样子，说不清哪里不对。
lines.en: There's something wrong with how I walk, but I can't say what.

lines.zh: 我往村子走，又突然回头。
lines.en: I head for the village, then turn back for no reason.

lines.zh: 地上的纹理跟着我一起脏了。
lines.en: The ground's texture goes dirty along with me.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边漏出杂音。
lines.en: I leak static as I walk.

lines.zh: 我停住，身体还在抖。
lines.en: I stop, and my body keeps twitching.

lines.zh: 我的叫声是一段空白。
lines.en: My squeal is a stretch of blank.

lines.zh: 我低头啃草，草消失了。
lines.en: I lower my head to graze and the grass is gone.

lines.zh: 我身上的伤，位置会变。
lines.en: The wounds on me keep changing places.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的火把，它灭了。
lines.en: I stare at your torch and it goes out.

lines.zh: 我在原地转，找不到北。
lines.en: I turn in place and can't find north.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子贴在地上，闻不到味。
lines.en: My snout is to the ground and there's no smell.

lines.zh: 这里刚才有棵树。
lines.en: There was a tree here just now.

lines.zh: 我的皮一块亮一块暗。
lines.en: My hide is bright in patches and dark in others.

lines.zh: 我在嚼，可嘴里什么都没有。
lines.en: I'm chewing, but there's nothing in my mouth.

lines.zh: 天空那边裂开一条缝。
lines.en: A seam opens in the sky over there.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，影子却在走。
lines.en: I stand still and my shadow walks.

lines.zh: 有个声音一直在我耳朵里。
lines.en: A sound keeps running inside my ears.

lines.zh: 我想叫，出来的是杂音。
lines.en: I try to squeal and static comes out.

lines.zh: 我眨了两次眼，中间少了点什么。
lines.en: I blink twice, and something is missing in between.

lines.zh: 这块地的草，已经全黑了。
lines.en: The grass here has all turned black.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里，闪了一下。
lines.en: You flicker once in my sight.

lines.zh: 我看不清你的脸。
lines.en: I can't make out your face.

lines.zh: 你身后有块地方是空的。
lines.en: There's an empty patch behind you.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，认不出你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and can't recognize you.

lines.zh: 你的火把，我劝你别点。
lines.en: Your torch. I'd advise against lighting it.

lines.zh: 我们是不是见过很多次？
lines.en: Haven't we met many times?

lines.zh: 你想摸我，手会穿过去。
lines.en: If you touch me, your hand will pass through.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一只在别处，别介意。
lines.en: One of my eyes is elsewhere — never mind.

lines.zh: 你身上有一格是错位的。
lines.en: One cell of you is out of place.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，别回头。
lines.en: While I'm looking at you, don't look back.

lines.zh: 我记得猪，可我不像猪。
lines.en: I remember being a pig. I don't look like one.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我听不见。
lines.en: What are you laughing at? I can't hear it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，一只在别处。
lines.en: One of my eyes is somewhere else.

lines.zh: 你走近，我就多一块空白。
lines.en: The closer you come, the more blank I have.

lines.zh: 这里的世界在漏。
lines.en: This world is leaking.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块。
lines.en: A piece of me came off.

lines.zh: 疼的感觉，延迟了两秒。
lines.en: The pain arrived two seconds late.

lines.zh: 我身上的空白变大了。
lines.en: The blank on me has grown.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我打散了。
lines.en: That scattered me.

lines.zh: 叫声卡在喉咙里，出不来。
lines.en: My squeal is stuck in my throat.

lines.zh: 我又多了一道坏掉的边。
lines.en: I've gained another broken edge.

lines.zh: 我缩起来，抖个不停。
lines.en: I curl up and keep twitching.

lines.zh: 不必再打，我已经不完整了。
lines.en: You don't have to hit me. I'm already incomplete.

lines.zh: 我看到我自己的碎片。
lines.en: I can see my own fragments.

lines.zh: 补回来一点，还是缺。
lines.en: Some of it comes back. Still missing.

lines.zh: 是萝卜？我看成两半了。
lines.en: A carrot? I see two of it.

lines.zh: 我闻到萝卜，可它断成两半。
lines.en: I smell a carrot, but it's split in two.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在吃，肚子还空。
lines.en: My mouth is eating and my belly's still empty.

lines.zh: 这味道中间断了一截。
lines.en: The smell cuts out halfway.

lines.zh: 我闻着味，走错了方向。
lines.en: Following the smell, I went the wrong way.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，在跳帧。
lines.en: What's in your hand keeps skipping frames.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，咬到空气。
lines.en: I bite down and get only air.

lines.zh: 给我，我保证不弄坏。
lines.en: Give it to me. I promise not to break it.

lines.zh: 我吃了它，它还在地上。
lines.en: I ate it, and it's still on the ground.

lines.zh: 这一口，我尝不出味。
lines.en: I can't taste a thing in that bite.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，跟丢了自己。
lines.en: I follow you and lose myself.

lines.zh: 你手里还有吗？刚才那份。
lines.en: Do you have more? The one just now.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我不知道饿在哪。
lines.en: I'm hungry, but I can't tell where.

lines.zh: 草也行，我什么都吃。
lines.en: Grass will do. I'll eat anything.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我看见三个。
lines.en: You hold it up and I see three.

lines.zh: 吃完这块，我想睡。
lines.en: After this one I want to sleep.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我漏了一块。
lines.en: You hit me and a piece of me goes missing.

lines.zh: 我的身体让开了，蹄子没有。
lines.en: My body moved aside; my hooves didn't.

lines.zh: 这一下，声音重复了三遍。
lines.en: That sound repeated three times.

lines.zh: 我们重叠了一瞬。
lines.en: For an instant we overlapped.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，然后从另一边出现。
lines.en: I hit you and come out the other side.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，我没动。
lines.en: You recoil. I don't move.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子穿过你的手臂。
lines.en: My snout passes through your arm.

lines.zh: 撞完这里的地变黑了。
lines.en: After the bump the ground here went black.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子，贴图已经错了。
lines.en: My snout's texture is wrong now.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩空了，身体还在。
lines.en: My hooves miss the ground, but my body stays.

lines.zh: 我记得有个同伴，形状模糊。
lines.en: I remember a companion. The shape is blurred.

lines.zh: 我靠近它，它闪了一下。
lines.en: I move close and it flickers.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，中间有空。
lines.en: We stand side by side with a gap between.

lines.zh: 它叫了一声，我没听全。
lines.en: It called once. I didn't catch all of it.

lines.zh: 猪圈的记忆还在。
lines.en: I still remember the pig pen.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，像一块坏掉的图。
lines.en: We bunch together like a broken image.

lines.zh: 我想碰它，手穿过去了。
lines.en: I reach for it and my hoof goes through.

lines.zh: 它不见了，地上还有它的影子。
lines.en: It's gone, and its shadow remains.

lines.zh: 这里不该有这么多空白。
lines.en: There shouldn't be this much blank here.

lines.zh: 我记不清它长什么样了。
lines.en: I can't remember what it looked like.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，它变成了草。
lines.en: I pick it up and it becomes grass.

lines.zh: 我嚼了两下，味道没了。
lines.en: Two chews and the taste is gone.

lines.zh: 我把它吞下去，它还在。
lines.en: I swallow it and it's still there.

lines.zh: 这块东西有个洞。
lines.en: There's a hole in this thing.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱，它散成碎片。
lines.en: I nudge it and it breaks into fragments.

lines.zh: 我收进嘴里，嘴里是空的。
lines.en: I put it in my mouth and my mouth is empty.

lines.zh: 我捡起来的，是刚才那块。
lines.en: What I picked up is the same one as before.

lines.zh: 我把它压进泥里，它不见了。
lines.en: I press it into the mud and it's gone.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我一秒就吃完。
lines.en: I finish it in a second.

lines.zh: 我吃完抬头，草又长回来了。
lines.en: I look up and the grass has grown back.

lines.zh: 那里有个东西，边缘是毛的。
lines.en: Something there with frayed edges.

lines.zh: 我看见它，又看不见了。
lines.en: I see it, then I don't.

lines.zh: 它在动，但位置没变。
lines.en: It's moving, but it hasn't moved.

lines.zh: 那个方向，天空是坏的。
lines.en: In that direction the sky is broken.

lines.zh: 我决定了，又忘了决定什么。
lines.en: I decide, then forget what I decided.

lines.zh: 有东西在叫我的名字。
lines.en: Something is calling my name.

lines.zh: 那块地上有块黑色。
lines.en: There's a black patch on that ground.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，虽然不知道是什么。
lines.en: I've locked on, though I don't know onto what.

lines.zh: 那边有火把的光，要灭了。
lines.en: Torchlight over there. It's about to go out.

lines.zh: 我该过去，还是该站着？
lines.en: Should I go over, or stand here?

lines.zh: 我朝它走，距离没有变。
lines.en: I walk toward it and the distance doesn't change.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，它退三步。
lines.en: Every step I take, it takes three back.

lines.zh: 它在重复同一个动作。
lines.en: It's repeating the same motion.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过，又走了一次。
lines.en: I've walked this path, and I walk it again.

lines.zh: 我听见它的脚步，多了一双。
lines.en: I hear its steps, and one extra pair.

lines.zh: 它转过来，脸是空的。
lines.en: It turns. Its face is empty.

lines.zh: 我停下来，它也停下来。
lines.en: I stop, and it stops.

lines.zh: 我们中间那块地，已经全黑了。
lines.en: The ground between us has gone completely black.

lines.zh: 它一直在同一个地方。
lines.en: It's been in the same place all along.

lines.zh: 我不知道我在追什么。
lines.en: I don't know what I'm chasing.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，穿过了它。
lines.en: I charge and pass straight through.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙咬到空白。
lines.en: I bite down on blank.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踢中了什么。
lines.en: My hoof connects with something.

lines.zh: 它尖叫，声音重复了四次。
lines.en: It screams, and the sound repeats four times.

lines.zh: 我把它推倒，它碎成方块。
lines.en: I shove it down and it breaks into blocks.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把地上的草变成了黑。
lines.en: That charge turned the grass black.

lines.zh: 我撞空了，自己摔了一跤。
lines.en: I miss and trip myself.

lines.zh: 它的血是几个像素。
lines.en: Its blood is a few pixels.

lines.zh: 我又撞了一下，它不见了。
lines.en: I charge again and it's gone.

lines.zh: 完了，还是没完？
lines.en: Is it over? Or isn't it?

lines.zh: 我从一块坏掉的草地里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a patch of broken grass.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看到的世界是错的。
lines.en: I open my eyes on a world that's wrong.

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着上一块的纹理。
lines.en: I still carry the texture of somewhere else.

lines.zh: 这里原本有只猪。
lines.en: There used to be a pig here.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，是一段静音。
lines.en: My first call is a stretch of silence.

lines.zh: 栅栏那边，有什么在看我。
lines.en: Something beyond the fence is watching.

lines.zh: 天空裂了一条缝，就在我头顶。
lines.en: A seam splits the sky right above me.

lines.zh: 我不知道我是怎么来的。
lines.en: I don't know how I got here.

lines.zh: 我的四肢先到，头还在加载。
lines.en: My limbs arrive first; my head is still loading.

lines.zh: 这里的火把，一根根灭了。
lines.en: The torches here are going out one by one.

lines.zh: 我站着，等世界把我补好。
lines.en: I stand and wait for the world to patch me in.

lines.zh: 这个世界补不上我这块。
lines.en: This world can't patch me in.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，烧出空洞。
lines.en: Fire burns through me and leaves holes.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，落地时少了一帧。
lines.en: I fall and lose a frame on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的身体变得更淡。
lines.en: Water pours in and my body thins out.

lines.zh: 炸开之后，我散成了许多块。
lines.en: After the blast I'm scattered into many pieces.

lines.zh: 那个洞后面是空的，什么也没有。
lines.en: Behind that hole there's nothing at all.

lines.zh: 一股力量把我的形状捏歪了。
lines.en: A force warps my shape out of true.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我不记得怎么吃。
lines.en: I'm hungry, and I don't remember how to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，我闪了三次。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I flicker three times.

lines.zh: 我掉进空白里，连轮廓都没了。
lines.en: I fall into the blank and even my outline is gone.
